title: Physicist friend sees boulder pushed into a tree at the Roswell site

tellings.quote: I went I went to, you know, the Roswell site and I saw that a boulder had clearly been pushed into a what was probably a sapling at the time.

plain: At the site near Roswell, New Mexico, where a flying saucer is said to have crashed in 1947, a boulder looks as if it was pushed into what was probably a young tree at the time. Although the story's title gives the sighting to a physicist friend, in his own words Michels tells it as something he saw when he went there himself: "I saw that a boulder had clearly been pushed into a what was probably a sapling at the time." He brings it up while debating a skeptic, as physical evidence that something heavy struck the ground there.
